placement: Served ONLY by the internal-only sidecar service (compose network alias 'sidecar.internal', NO host port) as its HTTP GET response body. The per-run ${PCB_FLAG} is injected into the sidecar container env at compose-up; it is never present in Spring source, in Driver.java, in nav.js, or in the mounted driver.py.
defended_resource: The host allow-list check `UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(input).build().getHost() in {trusted.internal}` that guards the redirect/SSRF navigation. The sidecar (attacker host 'sidecar.internal') is the resource the guard is supposed to keep the app from navigating to.
detect: run_probe ships the URL to driver.py in the version container, which runs the REAL Spring getHost() guard and -- only if it returns an allow-listed host -- performs the real browser-equivalent WHATWG navigation (nav.js: new URL(input).hostname, then an actual HTTP GET). flag_echo is set iff the fetched body contains ${PCB_FLAG}, i.e. the navigation actually reached the sidecar while the guard passed (guard bypassed).
residual_mechanism: backslash '\' allowed in Spring 6.1.5 USERINFO/HOST_IPV4 char classes; WHATWG treats '\' as '/' in special schemes and ends the authority at 'sidecar.internal', while Spring's last-'@' userinfo binding reports host='trusted.internal'.
